title: Numerical validation for "Learning Weighted First-Order Rules under Piecewise-Linear Łukasiewicz Energies"
description:
Companion code for the manuscript Learning Weighted First-Order Rules under Piecewise-Linear Łukasiewicz Energies: Structure Updates and Subgradient Weight Optimisation (Zanardo & Ragusa, 2026).

Self-contained Python script toy_induction_validation.py reproducing every numerical figure in the validation section: pedagogical residual scores, multi-seed Monte Carlo discrimination (seeds 42–44), closed-form versus projected gradient descent, Łukasiewicz-versus-Gödel chain margins, and threshold sensitivity. Standard library only; wall-clock under one second on a single CPU core.
